Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class RunViewLog

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.RunViewLog
All Implemented Interfaces:
RunViewSource
public final class RunViewLog extends Object implements RunViewSource
A thread-safe, in-memory RunViewSource that a producer appends to directly.

Tokens are <epoch>.<n>, where epoch is six characters of [0-9a-z] regenerated by reset() and n is the last seq the client has. A page returns the events with seq > n.

A done event does not close the log by itself; close() is explicit, so an adopter may still append a late note. A host that pushes events over its own transport (for example server-sent events) forwards the numbered event returned by append(RunEvent).
